name: IbogaBase
description: Independent public-interest reference for Iboga and Ibogaine research, safety, policy, culture, conservation, media, clinics, and field developments.
editorialPosition: Source-first public-interest reference that separates evidence, safety literature, cultural context, policy, media, and commercial claims by source type and uncertainty.
boundaries: No individualized medical or legal advice

primaryTopics.name: Iboga
primaryTopics.description: A careful introduction to Iboga as a Central African plant and cultural subject, separate from extracted Ibogaine and biomedical research claims.

primaryTopics.name: Ibogaine
primaryTopics.description: A source-backed overview of Ibogaine research, clinical evidence, safety risks, legal status, media claims, and policy activity.

primaryTopics.name: Noribogaine
primaryTopics.description: A plain-language distinction between Iboga, Ibogaine, and Noribogaine, including investigational status and claim boundaries.

primaryTopics.name: Analogs
primaryTopics.description: A plain-language reference for Ibogaine-adjacent analogs and derivatives, including 18-MC, tabernanthalog, sponsor claims, evidence type, and clinical status.

primaryTopics.name: Ibogaine Safety
primaryTopics.description: Plain-English Ibogaine safety reference focused on QT/QTc risk, cardiac screening, medication interactions, exclusions, and emergency readiness.

primaryTopics.name: Evidence by Condition
primaryTopics.description: Evidence-grade summaries for Ibogaine-related claims by condition, including human studies, limitations, outcomes, and safety signals.

primaryTopics.name: Ibogaine and Opioid Use Disorder
primaryTopics.description: A cautious guide to Ibogaine and opioid use disorder evidence, withdrawal interruption claims, relapse uncertainty, and safety limits.

primaryTopics.name: Parkinson's, TBI, and Neurology
primaryTopics.description: A cautious reference page for Ibogaine-related neurological claims, including Parkinson's disease, traumatic brain injury, mechanisms, and uncertainty.

primaryTopics.name: Law and Policy
primaryTopics.description: A living policy reference for Ibogaine law, state activity, country status, clinical-trial funding, and agency actions.

primaryTopics.name: Iboga Culture, History, and Stewardship
primaryTopics.description: A careful public guide to Iboga origins, Gabon, Bwiti and Bwete history, Misoko/Missoko and Fang contexts, conservation, sourcing ethics, reciprocity, and outsider limits.

primaryTopics.name: Podcasts and Media
primaryTopics.description: A directory-oriented reference for podcasts, interviews, documentaries, books, articles, videos, and media claims about Iboga and Ibogaine.

primaryTopics.name: Clinic Claims and Adverse Events
primaryTopics.description: A plain-language reference for reading Ibogaine clinic claims, success-rate statements, adverse events, safety standards, and conflicts of interest.

primaryTopics.name: Compare Iboga / Ibogaine / Noribogaine / Analogs
primaryTopics.description: Taxonomy of plant, alkaloid, metabolite, analogs, and form labels. Not interchangeable. No dosing or referrals.

primaryTopics.name: Listening Library
primaryTopics.description: Curated Listening Library (52 landmarks) with original summaries and media labels; link-out only.
